idea-plugin.name: AIGenCommitMsg
idea-plugin.description:
Generates a Git commit message from staged changes and inserts it into the commit message field.

Features

  • One-click generation from the commit toolbar, right next to the commit message history button (default shortcut Ctrl+Alt+G).
  • DeepSeek Chat Completions API (default base URL https://api.deepseek.com, default model deepseek-chat), with configurable base URL, model, temperature, commit message language and Conventional Commits.
  • Custom generation rules appended to the system prompt with the highest priority.
  • API token stored in the system keychain when available (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service) with IDE PasswordSafe fallback, plus a built-in Test Connection button with readable errors for invalid token (401/403), insufficient balance (402), rate limit (429), timeout and network failures.
  • Token hardening: settings never refill the plaintext token, a masked summary and a clear-token action are provided, secrets are redacted from notifications and errors, the base URL is restricted to https (official host by default), and staged diffs are scanned and masked before sending.
  • Searchable commit-message language picker with 200+ languages and region variants (CN, TW, US, GB, BR, PT, SA, JP and more), filtered by country code, English name or native name.
  • Offline template fallback when no API token is configured, so the action always works.

Configuration

Open Settings > Tools > AIGenCommitMsg (DeepSeek), paste a DeepSeek API token, optionally adjust the model or generation rules, and click Apply. The token is never written to project files; it goes to the platform keychain or the IDE PasswordSafe.

Supported IDE

2026.2 and later (build 262+), including 2026.2.4 (build 262.11879.119). Only a minimum build is declared, so IDE upgrades do not invalidate the plugin. Uses the standard VCS APIs and works with any Git repository.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.8.0: rebuilt against Rider 2026.2.4 (build 262.11879.119); only a minimum build (262) is declared and there is no upper build bound, so the "requires IDE build 262.* or earlier" error after an IDE upgrade no longer occurs. Adds upgrade notes for the old RiderGenGitMsg 0.3.0 plugin (different plugin id, must be uninstalled manually).
  • 0.7.0: token security hardening and three-platform system keychain support (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service) with PasswordSafe fallback; no plaintext refill in settings, masked/clear actions, centralized redaction, https-only base URL policy, automatic legacy plaintext migration and pre-send diff secret masking.
  • 0.6.0: multilingual commit-message language picker (200+ entries, searchable, random order), language-aware system prompt, legacy zh/en migration and English fallback notice.
  • 0.5.0: renamed the display name to AIGenCommitMsg to keep it unique on Marketplace.
  • 0.4.1: added plugin icons (SVG for IDE, 40px/80px PNG for Marketplace), real vendor link and Marketplace-ready description.
  • 0.4.0: switched to a neutral plugin id for Marketplace compliance.
  • 0.3.0: added custom commit-message rules and a restore-default-rules button.
  • 0.2.0: DeepSeek-only generation, PasswordSafe token storage and token test button.
